$comment: The horde ladder. Ordered cheapest -> most capable. The NUMBER of rungs is the number of entries here: 3 models -> 3 rungs, 2 -> 2. The /delegate skill reads this to know which model serves which entropy band. Edit `model` to pin a rung to a specific model (alias haiku|sonnet|opus, or a full model id like claude-haiku-4-5-20251001). Add or remove a rung to change the ladder; the framework routes across whatever rungs exist. The HIGHEST rung (orchestrator: true) is the main agent / WARBOSS itself — work that lands there is decomposed or escalated, never dispatched to a subagent. Every lower rung is dispatched to the `doer` subagent with `model` set to that rung's model.

prices.$comment: BLENDED $/MILLION-tokens, used ONLY by the manual `scripts/ledger.mjs add` fallback (which has just an aggregate token count). The automatic hook path uses `pricing` below instead — prefer it. Set a model to null to log tokens only.

pricing.$comment: ACCURATE per-class $/MILLION-tokens, used by BOTH automatic meters: scripts/meter-subagent.mjs (SubagentStop -> the doer/'do' band) and scripts/meter-orchestrator.mjs (Stop -> the WARBOSS/'decide' band). Each transcript carries the real input/output/cache split, so USD here is precise — not blended. Keys are matched to a transcript's model id by SUBSTRING (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6' -> 'sonnet'); the same match maps a model to its ladder `tier` for the summary board. VERIFY against current Anthropic pricing before trusting the dollar figures; as of authoring, cache_read is ~0.1x input and cache_write ~1.25x input. Set a model to null to log tokens only.

ladder.band: near-zero residual entropy — a literal machine could satisfy the contract: exact entry point, criteria as concrete input->expected, every second reading already killed
moderate residual entropy — decided but a literal machine would likely misread it: subtle invariants, non-trivial logic, or a slice that may need finer decomposition
high residual entropy — not yet decided. Stays with the WARBOSS (main agent): decompose, resolve forks, or escalate to the user. Never dispatched.
